FIELD.name: solution_num
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Solution number in the solution set

FIELD.name: color_term
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Color term of the plate, characterizing color response of the emulsion and filter used

FIELD.name: num_calib_stars
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Number of stars that were actually used for photometric calibration in the annular bin

FIELD.name: num_bright_stars
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Number of bright stars that were actually used for photometric calibration in the annular bin. Bright-star calibration was handled separately and then merged with the calibration curve.

FIELD.name: num_outliers
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Number of stars that were found to be outliers of the photometric calibration curve in the annular bin

FIELD.name: bright_limit
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Brightest source magnitude among calibration stars, belonging to the current astrometric solution, in the plate natural photometric system

FIELD.name: faint_limit
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Estimated faint limit of the current astrometric solution in the plate natural photometric system

FIELD.name: mag_range
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Magnitude range between the bright and faint limit

FIELD.name: rmse_min
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Minimum root-mean-square (RMS) error estimate for magnitudes in the plate natural photometric system

FIELD.name: rmse_median
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Median root-mean-square (RMS) error estimate for magnitudes in the plate natural photometric system

FIELD.name: rmse_max
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Maximum root-mean-square (RMS) error estimate for magnitudes in the plate natural photometric system
